# SYNESIS_E122 — Warning

## Description

Unknown relation `RELATION`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the relation `RELATION` is not in the RELATIONS of any CHAIN field in the template.
  Use the name exactly as declared in the template (case matters).
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **UnknownRelation**: `block`, `relation`, `from_field`
